scripts.dev: npm run db:setup --workspace server && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --workspace server" "npm run dev --workspace web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace server && npm run build --workspace web
scripts.start:render: npm run db:reset -w server -- --with-samples && ALLOWED_ORIGINS=$RENDER_EXTERNAL_URL APP_URL=$RENDER_EXTERNAL_URL npm start -w server
